input.body:
label: feature
file: src/api/reports.ts

This is a request for new behaviour: today the export endpoint only supports `csv` and `xlsx` (see `SUPPORTED_FORMATS` in `src/exportUtils.ts` and the `renderExport`/`:id/export` route in `src/api/reports.ts`, which dispatches to `writeCsv`/`writeXlsx`). Adding TSV would mean adding a `tsv` writer under `src/export/` and wiring it into `renderExport` and `SUPPORTED_FORMATS`, which is a legitimate feature request (and would also fix the comma-in-description escaping issue the reporter describes, since tab-delimited output sidesteps comma collisions).

text: This is a feature request for adding TSV export support. The main place to add it would be `src/exportUtils.ts` (format list) along with a new writer, but the primary routing logic that would need updating is in `src/api/reports.ts`.
